subject: LumenBridge: Incident notification and proposed evidence onboarding / sanitization plan
messages:
From: LumenBridge Security <security@lumenbridge.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com
Cc: alex.park@lumenbridge.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 04:18:00 +0000
Subject: Initial notification: short-lived elevated token error rate (eu-west-1) — request for IR onboarding

Hi Marissa / Jonas,

Quick heads-up from LumenBridge Security. On 2026-12-03 04:12:00 UTC we observed a short-lived spike in token validation errors for requests routed through eu-west-1. We do not currently have evidence of exfiltration or customer-visible data loss, but the volume and timing warrant a formal IR handshake and evidence onboarding so we can complete our internal audit.

What we can share immediately: a small telemetry excerpt and an initial timeline snapshot (attached: sample_telemetry_excerpt.json). What we need from you to proceed:
- Confirmation of the IR contact and preferred evidence transfer mechanism (SFTP vs secure SharePoint).
- SIG/CAIQ mapping or SOC 2 control references for data retention and access logging (we're mapping controls to our SOC 2 audit).
- A point of contact for redaction/sanitization review (we typically allow a 48-hour review window).

Goal: get a minimal evidence bundle ingested by EOD your time on 2026-12-04, then plan a short postmortem readout next week.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Incident Response Lead
LumenBridge Security
security@lumenbridge.com

Attachment: sample_telemetry_excerpt.json (attachment stub — sanitized JSON lines, 3KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: LumenBridge Security <security@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com, neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 03 Dec 2026 12:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial notification: short-lived elevated token error rate (eu-west-1) — request for IR onboarding

Alex — thanks for the notification and for the sample data. Marissa here (security ops / incident liaison at Redwood). I've looped in Jonas (platform reliability) and Neha (SOC 2 / customer evidence owner).

Quick answers and next steps:
- Preferred transfer mechanism: secure SFTP is fine for log bundles (we also support short-term signed Drive links). If you prefer SFTP, please send the public key and desired username; we'll provision a temporary, auditable account scoped to the LumenBridge evidence directory for 7 days.
- We will provide a SIG-to-controls crosswalk and our CAIQ mapping artifact; Neha will attach the evidence matrix and a sanitized example from our side.
- Redaction review: 48 hours is reasonable. We'll label anything with PII and coordinate redaction offline.

I am attaching a draft IR timeline (RBW_IR_timeline_v0.1.pdf) with our initial containment steps and ask that you review and annotate anything you need preserved for your audit. Proposed schedule:
- 2026-12-04 09:00 UTC: SFTP window enabled and evidence push (both directions).
- 2026-12-06 16:00 UTC: Postmortem readout (30 minutes) — remote.

Please confirm SFTP details or a Drive link and we'll provision access and start the transfer.

Marissa Cole
Principal, Security Operations
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | +1 415 555 0182

Attachment: RBW_IR_timeline_v0.1.pdf (attachment stub — 12 pages, timeline + notes)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, LumenBridge Security <security@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 04 Dec 2026 09:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial notification: evidence matrix and sanitized sample

Hi Alex / Marissa / Jonas — adding the evidence artefacts from our side.

Attached to this message:
- evidence_matrix.csv — mapping of telemetry types to SOC 2 and SIG controls, with suggested redaction flags.
- sanitized_logs_sample.ndjson — one-hour sample (sanitized) covering the observed spike window.
- sftp_instructions.txt — details for key upload, username, expiration (we will create a time-limited account with read-only permissions for your upload).

Notes / clarifications:
- The sample is intentionally sanitized: hashed user_ids, removed auth header values, and a pseudonymized request_id column. If you require additional raw fields for forensic reasons, we can arrange a secure handoff but will need an authorization request and a limited retention window.
- The SIG/CAIQ crosswalk in evidence_matrix.csv includes pointers to where we store artifacts long-term (retention buckets) and the control owner contact.

Next actions for LumenBridge:
1) Send the public SSH key you want us to authorize (reply to this thread).
2) Confirm acceptance of the 48-hour redaction review window.
3) Indicate whether you want us to include any tracer packet captures or deeper KV cache traces; we will need an explicit request for those.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Compliance & Controls Lead
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

Attachments: evidence_matrix.csv (attachment stub), sanitized_logs_sample.ndjson (attachment stub), sftp_instructions.txt (attachment stub)
From: Alex Park <alex.park@lumenbridge.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 05 Dec 2026 14:27:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Initial notification: evidence onboarding / acknowledgment

Neha / Marissa — thanks for the fast turnaround and the artifacts. We confirm receipt of the sanitized sample and the matrix.

We will:
- Upload our public SSH key by EOD 2026-12-04 (in this thread) — please provision the temporary account with the permissions described.
- Accept the 48-hour redaction review window. We'll tag any requested redactions in the RBW_IR_timeline_v0.1.pdf and return them to you before the window closes.
- We do not require raw KV cache dumps at this time. If our audit team later requests deeper traces, we'll follow the authorization flow you outlined.

Can you confirm the SFTP username and the exact UTC window once you provision? Also please include the Jira ticket id in your SFTP audit log entry so we can match uploads (we will reference SEC-8243).

Appreciate the collaboration — we'll plan to join the postmortem on 2026-12-06 16:00 UTC unless you propose otherwise.

Regards,
Alex Park
Incident Response Lead
LumenBridge Security
security@lumenbridge.com

Attachment: lumenbridge_acknowledge_eml.txt (attachment stub)
